intro.title: Before you start
intro.privacyTitle: Your data stays on this computer
intro.privacy: Claude Memory Sync processes everything on this computer only. It does not connect to the internet and sends no memories, chats or files to any server or cloud service. There are no accounts, analytics or usage data. Your data leaves this computer only when you move a bundle or backup yourself.
intro.icloud: If Desktop or Documents is synced with iCloud, macOS, not the app, syncs the bundles and full backups saved there.
intro.foldersTitle: macOS will now ask about three folders

why.desktop: Bundles and full backups are saved here by default, and bundles here are found.
why.documents: Workspace files are found and backed up, and projects are matched to their counterparts on the other device by their git remotes.
why.downloads: Bundles you download from another device are found automatically.

intro.denied: Without them, memories, chats and Claude settings are still backed up and transferred; they live in the Claude folder, which needs no permission. Workspace files and bundles in a folder you do not allow are not seen, and projects there are not matched by themselves on import; bundles can still be opened by choosing the file and saved to another folder. You can allow access later in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Files and Folders.
intro.again: macOS may ask again with every new version of the app.

help.title: Backup types
help.summary: In short: Back up now to return to an earlier state on this computer; Full backup before you reset or replace the computer.
help.manual: Taken with Back up now. A copy, at that moment, of what you chose in Backup contents (at first every memory, workspace file and Claude setting; chats too if you want), kept in the backup folder. If something goes wrong, Restore this backup takes you back to that moment. If the computer is reset, it is erased with it.
help.daily: The same contents, taken automatically every day at the time you set. As many as you set in Settings are kept; if nothing changed, no new file is written.
help.before: Taken automatically before every import, restore and undo. Whatever Backup contents says, it holds every memory, workspace file and Claude setting; Undo in History uses these backups.
help.full: Taken with Full backup, before you reset or replace the computer. Besides the memories and every chat, the app's settings, version history, activity log and every backup go into one file. Keep it off the computer; opening it on a fresh install continues where you left off.
help.export: Made in Transfer → Create bundle, for another device. Only the memories and workspaces you pick go in, and the other device merges them both ways.

full.title: Full backup before resetting the computer
full.intro: Besides memories, every chat, workspace files and Claude settings, the app's settings, version history, matches, activity log and every backup taken so far go into one file. After the reset, install the app and open this file: everything goes back where it was and the app continues where it left off.

backup.title: Automatic backup
backup.sub: You choose what daily and manual backups take in Backup contents. Pre-operation backups always take every memory, workspace file and Claude setting.
backup.dailySub: The time is set in 5-minute steps and the backup starts right at it. If the computer is off at that time, the backup is taken when it starts. If nothing changed since the previous backup, no new file is written.
